title: The store keeps DCLab Code's scripted live-test sessions apart, as agent episodes only
request: The owner (2026-10-26), asked whether the live tests' data was stored for the six models: 'make the store also read DCLab Code test homes under agent_runs, marked as scripted (agent episodes only, never my labels), and run future live tests in a project inside R&D.'
spec: store keeper dclab_code (32.33) and its sets builder (32.34)
plan: the keeper finds scripted test homes under agent_runs/live_tests
keeps their sessions on this repository or a scratch folder apart under dclab_code/tests/<folder>/
the sets read every act there as the script's
live tests work in a project inside R&D from now on

decisions.decision: Only a home whose config says decidedBy script is read
decisions.why: a person's own home placed there must never be read as a test, nor a test as a person's

decisions.decision: In a test home, a session on a scratch folder is kept; one on another repository is counted only
decisions.why: the scratch projects are the tests' own throwaway folders; another repository may hold private work

decisions.decision: A test home's session is scripted as a whole
decisions.why: a record older than the by field counts as a person's in the owner's home; a test's never may

change: R&D dclab_rnd/store/keepers/dclab_code.py (test_homes, _home_sources, SCRATCH), dclab_rnd/store/sets/dclab_code.py (TEST_RECORD, TEST_INDEX, Session.scripted), tests.

findings.defect: the live tests' DCLab Code sessions never reached the training store
findings.scenario: about 36 sessions of SDK messages, thinking and asks kept only on disk under agent_runs/live_tests/*/home
findings.cause: the keeper read only ~/.dclab-code, and kept only sessions on this repository
findings.fix: scripted test homes read and kept apart; their sessions agent episodes only

findings.defect: a method inserted between a decorator and its function
findings.scenario: every sets test: TypeError Session._auto() takes 2 positional arguments but 3 were given
findings.cause: the new method went right after @staticmethod
findings.fix: the method placed before the decorator

measurements.name: the real agent_runs
measurements.gate: only scripted homes, nothing of another repository kept
measurements.result: 5 scripted homes found, 36 session records kept, one home's other-folder sessions counted only

outcome: The live tests' sessions reach the store at its next run as agent episodes, and future live tests run inside R&D.
lessons: When a rule keeps data out, ask the owner before widening it, and widen it only as far as asked.
risks: a test home without decidedBy script is not read; older test homes made before that setting are left out
